leveraged.text: Uses leverage — built to trade, not to hold for income

big_fall.text: Lost more than half its value at its worst point

speculative.text: Rides on one stock or on crypto — speculative

note.text: An issuer's note (ETN/ETP), not a fund — you rely on the bank that issued it

own_money.text: Pays you with your own money — most of the payout came out of capital, or the price fell over 10% a year

cash_like.text: No better than cash — total return within 2%/yr of T-bills

young.text: Short track record — under 2 years of prices, so the score leans on similar funds

small.text: Small (under $100M) or thinly traded — may close, and buying/selling costs more
